title: Move Spaces to End
statement: Given a char array, move all spaces to the end while preserving the order of non-space characters.

What wording signals stand out? move spaces, preserve order, in place.
What is the brute force idea? Use extra loops or repeated checks.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a clean two pointers solution.
What are the edge cases? Empty-like input, single values, duplicates, and boundaries.
What is the complexity? For most of these easy tasks, aim for O(n) time unless sorting is required.
